name: session-title
description: Names each session from what it works on, e.g. "fix: resolve hook timeout on first prompt", and renames it when the main task changes

model.title: Naming model
model.description: Model alias or id that writes the title

waitMs.title: First-prompt wait (ms)
waitMs.description: How long the first prompt waits for its title; a slower title shows from the next prompt. 0 never waits

checkTurns.title: Turns between title checks
checkTurns.description: Answered turns between two checks of whether the main task changed
